When the system freezes, does it eventually recover, or are you forced to manually reboot the machine?

If this is a driver issue, you might have some information in the system logs. After freezing:

- If you can switch to another TTY (e.g. <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>F2</kbd> through <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>F7</kbd>), run `dmesg` and check if you can find messages regarding driver issues.
  - To return to the GUI session, it's usually tty2 or tty7.
- If the system is unresponsive and you have to manually reboot it, run `journalctl -b -1` after rebooting to access the last boot logs, and check if you can find mentions of driver issues.
